notes: New to the grouped package (no Chapter 2 twin). Applies to 10 or more grouped dwellings served by a communal street; site.communal_street_serves_lots is read as the number of dwellings the communal street serves. parking.pedestrian_access_separate is read as 'clearly delineated or separate' (either satisfies the limb).
text: For 10 or more grouped dwellings that are served by a communal street, a pedestrian path is provided as follows: ii. clearly delineated or separate from the vehicular access; and
